visualCharacteristics.purpose: 16:9 image with overlapping meta caption and a quote headline plus blockquote
visualCharacteristics.layout: Image with caption overlapping its foot, quote below; from 1280px the quote floats over the image's left half on a lilac veil
notable: Image may be wrapped in a link
Placed after a one-cell columns block it becomes that grid's second column
no-caption variant treats all text before the quote as headline

contentPattern.structure: One cell: a picture paragraph (optionally linked), a caption paragraph, a headline paragraph, and a blockquote

usage: Use to feature a single quote or statement paired with a large image
reuseGuidance: Fits one image plus one short quote with optional caption; not for multiple quotes or carousels of testimonials
